headline: Nadia enters the real native studio knowing it works as a teaching companion
overview: The actual iPhone app explains visual planning, glanceable Teach Mode, and local-first privacy before opening a prepared class in the native studio.
payoff: Nadia reaches a native prepared class with Teach this class visible and understands what remains outside this bounded first-run walk.
